title: 10章、活着是一种责任
lines: 听到这话，篝火旁的年轻人嬉笑之声都为之一顿，对着那个不修边幅的中年人怒目而视，半晌后，有人开口说道：“是又怎样？哪个国度没有几个软骨头？但是全国上下尽皆软骨头的又有几个？不说玉石俱焚的繁星落，多少个香火古城全城上下无怨无悔？就说接连大战之后仍旧不断驰援的张荼张先生，以及步光步先生还有苏定秦等人，你为何却是只字不提？”
那中年人灌了一口酒，讥笑道：“可是偌大神州，又有几个张荼，又有几个步光，又有几个苏定秦，你们没有看见么？即使是建邺城之中依旧有张独鹿和水心留守，更别说张荼出身的建邺城，更是有着近十位如今的巅峰强者守护！”
男子的声音之中，充满了浓浓的不甘和怨怼。
小胖子闷闷的说：“据说，建邺城是张荼一手搭建，南下也是为了寻觅故友，可是结果呢？战江城，守镇江，援建邺，入扈渎，可是换回来了什么？接二连三的自己人刺杀。换做是我，我早就掉头回转琅琊，与兄弟一起并肩作战了。还有什么比守护好自己父老乡亲来的更重要？所以，大叔，你在这里酸什么？你又有什么资格在这里说三道四？”
“怎么湛蓝擂台上从来没有见过你？”
篝火旁的年轻人纷纷叫嚷了起来。毕竟正是青春热血的时候，加上了秩序不断的崩溃，所有的社会规则都变成了以往约定俗成的道德规则的时候，很多人也更加的刚硬了起来，纷纷碰杯，大口痛饮了起来。
中年人的面色愈加的阴沉，但是语调却是不徐不疾的说道：“他张荼可怜，那扈渎城的数十万无辜群众就不可怜了么？你们在这里讥讽瀛州被妖族连破五城，却看不见我神洲大地已经有近乎十座古城破灭。同为人族，你们的眼界为何如此的狭隘？今时今日，应该是全人类万众一心，共同抵挡妖祸，而像张荼这种人，顶在第一线本就是应该的。”
“呵呵，什么东西，跟你讲道理你在这里胡搅蛮缠，什么叫做全人类的事业？如今妖祸肆虐？可有一人来驰援我九州？就这么跟你说吧，我九州跟瀛州，那是山川异域，不共戴天！若是他们抗住了妖祸，那么日后，也定要马踏瀛洲，扬我国威，懂么你？”
瀛州和九州的仇恨，并不久远，不过区区百余年，在大齐建国之前，瀛州曾经欲要攻破九州，虽然功败垂成，但是最终的结果却是在九州大地之上犯下了令人发指的罪行。
这一份仇恨，已经铭记在了九州每一个人的血脉之中，哪怕是没有人叫嚷着复仇，但是所有的热血之人，都在默默等待着一个机会，待到红旗满天下，马踏瀛洲赏樱花。
content_zh:
阑珊迈步，就像是离开水的鱼儿一般，张荼大口地呼吸着略带焦灼的空气，贪婪且难以自持，好像只有这样，才能掩饰内心的恐惧和恐慌。

    像是用尽了全身的力气，张荼是接近挣扎地登上了四楼。

    他自己心中如明镜一般清楚，从年少懵懂到中年的沧桑，他太明白云裳的性格……

    果不其然，行至四楼，唯有这一家门户紧闭。

    就像是被关闭在了希望之外。

    此时此刻，压抑了十余年的暴虐在张荼的心中酝酿，危险的神色在张荼的眼中不断的闪烁。

    “啪！”

    张荼蓦然回首，猩红的眼眸看着突然来到的男子。

    此人，已是二十出头的模样，张荼认得此人，云裳的弟弟，亲弟弟，云苍。

    “哥，你怎么在这里？”

    云苍看着眼前不断释放着危险气息的男子，看着那猩红的眸子，心中一阵发寒，但同时又感到一阵的心疼。

    自己，也在找自己的姐姐。

    可是，不仅姐姐不见了，父母也不见了。

    张荼紧闭双眸，不想在云苍面前露出自己的脆弱，虽说自己最终没有和云裳走到一起，可是这小子却是一直把自己当做姐夫对待，这也导致了他对于云裳的男友没有一丝丝的好脸色。

    竭尽全力最后一丝幸存的理智将自己的疯狂收回，可是谁也没有想到，在日后，会酿出什么样的果实。

    “云苍？你怎么在这里？叔叔阿姨和你姐呢？”

    “啪嗒”

    老房子，依旧是用钥匙来开门。

    云苍走了进去，淡然地开口道：“我还要问你呢，如今天地大变，我当然要第一时间回来看看，方才我在帮隔壁小区，小区的王大爷说看到你匆忙地来到家中，我这不就赶紧回来了么？真不知道现在世界怎么了？地震，洪水，现在竟是赫然来了这么一遭，哥，你说是千载难遇的大地震么？”

    张荼木然地跟着云苍走进屋中，看着眼前熟悉的摆放和家具，心中悲戚再难遏制，自己幼时与云裳关系不可谓不近，而开明的云父云母乐的见得三个小孩其乐融融地相处，也曾经明暗中按时张荼主动一些……

    如今一切物是人非。

    张荼不断地大口呼吸，说道：“不是地震，一言半语也说不清，你只需要知道，新的世界来临了，未来谁也不知道。”

    云苍在听到了张荼的话语，身形微微地一怔，随即便是恢复了正常，说道：“我，不知道，我回家之后，便是一切都是这般，就像大变之时，家里没有人一般，如今电话打不通，我也不知道爸妈去哪里了，我问过对门，隔壁的丽姐说，下午的时候，看到爸妈一起出去，然后就再也没有回来。”

    张荼沉默不语，一时无言，只是颓然地靠在墙壁之上，整个人越发的呆滞。

    “哥，你说，我爸妈没事吧。”云苍的声音就像是喉咙之中堵了什么一般，嘶嘶哑的听不清楚：“我大姐呢？哥……她不是跟你一起上班么？你没事，那我姐呢？”

    张荼踉踉跄跄地来到了云裳的房间，看到床头柜摆放的小箱子，一切的一切，如同记忆中一般无二 ，那个小箱子之中，摆放的便是青春之时，张荼与她共同的点点滴滴，有上课时候传递的纸条，也有稚嫩的心意，更有数之不尽的小礼品。

    “砰！”

    云苍重重地拍在门上，近乎低沉的嘶吼，如同一只遍体鳞伤的孤狼，张荼第一次看到自己的这个便宜弟弟以这种姿态面对自己，甚是新奇。

    “我姐呢？啊！你说话啊！”
content_en:
Lanshan stepped forward, like a fish out of water, Zhang Tu breathed in the slightly anxious air, greedy and uncontrollable, as if this was the only way to hide the fear and panic in his heart.

As if he had exhausted all his strength, Zhang Tu climbed to the fourth floor almost struggling.

He knows as clearly as a mirror in his own mind that he understands Yun Shang's character very well, from being young and ignorant to the vicissitudes of middle age...

Sure enough, when we reached the fourth floor, only this one was closed.

It was like being shut out of hope.

At this moment, the violence that had been suppressed for more than ten years was brewing in Zhang Tu's heart, and a dangerous look flashed in Zhang Tu's eyes.

"Crack!"

Zhang Tu suddenly looked back, his scarlet eyes looking at the man who suddenly arrived.

This man looked like he was in his early twenties. Zhang Tu recognized this man, Yun Shang's younger brother, his biological brother, Yun Cang.

"Brother, why are you here?"

Yun Cang looked at the man in front of him who was constantly releasing a dangerous aura, and looked at the scarlet eyes. He felt a chill in his heart, but at the same time he felt distressed.

I am also looking for my sister.

However, not only is my sister missing, but my parents are also missing.

Zhang Tu closed his eyes tightly, not wanting to show his vulnerability in front of Yun Cang. Although he did not get together with Yun Shang in the end, this boy always treated him as his brother-in-law, which also led to him not having a good look at Yun Shang's boyfriend.

He tried his best to take back his madness with the last bit of surviving sanity, but no one thought about what kind of fruits it would produce in the future.

"Yun Cang? Why are you here? Where are your uncle, aunt and your sister?"

"Click"

In old houses, you still use a key to open the door.

Yun Cang walked in and said calmly: "I still want to ask you. Now that the world has changed a lot, of course I have to come back and take a look as soon as possible. Just now I was helping the community next door. Uncle Wang from the community said that I saw you coming home in a hurry. Didn't I come back quickly? I really don't know what's going on in the world now? Earthquakes, floods, and now this is happening unexpectedly. Brother, do you think this is a once-in-a-lifetime earthquake?"

Zhang Tu followed Yun Cang into the house numbly. Looking at the familiar arrangements and furniture in front of him, the sadness in his heart could no longer be contained. He had been close to Yun Shang when he was a child, and the enlightened Yun father and Yun Mu were happy to see the three children getting along happily. Zhang Tu had also secretly taken the initiative on time...

Nowadays everything has changed.

Zhang Tu kept taking deep breaths and said: "It's not an earthquake. I can't explain it in just a few words. You just need to know that a new world has arrived, and no one knows the future."

When Yun Cang heard Zhang Tu's words, he was slightly startled, and then returned to normal, and said: "I, I don't know, everything was like this after I came home, just like when there was a big change, there was no one at home. Now the phone can't be reached, and I don't know where my parents are. I asked the door opposite, and Sister Li next door said that in the afternoon, I saw my parents going out together, and then they never came back."

Zhang Tu remained silent, speechless for a moment, just leaning against the wall slumped, his whole person becoming more and more sluggish.

"Brother, tell me, are my parents okay?" Yun Cang's voice sounded like there was something stuck in his throat, and he was hoarse and couldn't hear clearly: "Where's my eldest sister? Brother... doesn't she go to work with you? You're okay, what about my sister?"

Zhang Tu staggered to Yun Shang's room and saw the small box placed on the bedside table. Everything was the same as in his memory. In that small box, there were bits and pieces that Zhang Tu and she had in common when they were young, including notes passed during class, young thoughts, and countless small gifts.

"Bang!"

Yun Cang slapped the door heavily and roared almost low, like a lone wolf covered in bruises. It was the first time for Zhang Tu to see his cheap brother facing him in this manner. It was very strange.

"Where is my sister? Ah! You speak!"
